notes:
What's new in 0.1.127:
- Browser player: "Resume from ...?" is offered from this browser's own newer spot even when the home PC has none; each household member's spots are kept separately, so nobody is offered another member's position; the intro skip waits while the question is open; Cinema Mode's pre-show still starts on a fresh film.
- Browser player: a seek from the lock screen while the screen is off is saved, and switching to screen-off audio never overwrites the saved spot with zero; Previous steps over a missing episode to the nearest one you have; the M (mute) and C (subtitles) keys also work with Shift held; on phones, a late full-screen rotation error no longer undoes a newer one.
- Music in the browser: album search ignores punctuation and accents (acdc live finds AC/DC (Live), rock and roll finds Rock & Roll); a volume change during a crossfade is remembered; a last song that cannot play follows Repeat all instead of leaving playback stuck; an artist's guest appearances follow the album order shown on the artist page; an album radio mix still opens with its album when every song on it was played recently.
- Audiobooks and podcasts: a late answer from the previous book can no longer add or delete a bookmark on the book you are on; an older Change folder result can no longer replace a newer folder choice; a damaged front cover no longer hides a usable back cover; a podcast feed with an unusual document header (an address in square brackets) can be followed, and nothing extra is downloaded.
- Live TV: when the free tuner cannot be reached and the other is busy, the message says the tuner is unreachable instead of all tuners busy; a new guide source no longer inherits the old source's long retry wait; Cancel, Delete and Remove on Recordings show why the home PC refused; pressing Record twice after a guide end-time correction no longer schedules a programme twice; long programme details scroll on short phone screens.
- Library and metadata: a show folder named like an extras folder is still listed when its season folders use other languages (Saison, Temporada, Staffel, Säsong, Specials); impossible dates in episode names (such as 2024.02.30) are no longer read as air dates; in Fix match, a slow successful save is always applied; the last country you pick on a title sheet or in Discover's where-to-watch picker is the one saved; a late metadata settings save no longer hides a download result; screen readers name the missing-poster card in the sequels view once; Photos reports the full number of located photos when the map shows only part of them.
- Subtitles: an OpenSubtitles download named .srt that is really WebVTT is saved as .vtt so it plays; older Windows subtitle files show curly quotes, dashes and the euro sign correctly.
- Watching together: a late pause no longer rewinds everybody to an older spot after a newer seek; in Live Rooms, a late block or report answer no longer closes a newer dialog; on the Movie Night TV page the arrow keys work inside the claim-code box; Movie Night guest search and the smart playlist preview show only the answer for your newest typing.
- Sharing with another household: a guest whose share access has expired can no longer load the shared library's posters.
- Settings and start-up: a slow earlier save of the nightly backup keep box no longer erases the number you are typing; while Appearance has unsaved layout edits, Layout Studio and Import layout are turned off so they cannot overwrite them; if you turned Beebo off in Task Manager's start-up list, Beebo no longer switches it back on when it starts, and a diagnostics file shows the real reason.
- Games and Jellyfin apps: Number Grid gives the same perfect score when cells were restored; Jellyfin apps list episodes in the right order even with very large episode numbers.
- Windows only. The phone app (1.73, build 145) and Beebo Auto (1.22) are separate releases.
- Automated checks: the full Windows desktop test suite ran on the first group of merged changes (2,083 files) with no real failures; one test failed only from test-machine memory and passed with more memory, and 3 timing-sensitive tests passed on a re-run. All 581 files touched by the second group of changes then passed. Each change had a clear code review (two for protected changes), and the signed installer passed its signature, size, converter, connection-helper and language checks. The full suite was not re-run after the version-number change, and no person has installed this version or tried its in-app update yet.
- Release source commit 797c7e4c7.
